sentences.en: The 《八宅明镜》 *Bāzhái Míngjìng* (Mirror of the Eight Mansions) takes the "Eight Mansions" (bāzhái) as its core framework: by the direction of the sitting mountain (zuòshān) it divides dwellings into two groups — Qián (the Creative / Heaven ☰), Duì (the Joyous / Lake ☱), Gèn (Keeping Still / Mountain ☶), and Kūn (the Receptive / Earth ☷) (the West Four Mansions) and Zhèn (the Arousing / Thunder ☳), Xùn (the Gentle / Wind ☴), Lí (the Clinging / Fire ☲), and Kǎn (the Abysmal / Water ☵) (the East Four Mansions); each mansion has eight positions — Generating Breath (shēngqì), Heavenly Doctor (tiānyī), Prolonged Years (yánnián), and Stationary Position (fúwèi) (the Four Auspicious), together with Misfortune (huòhài), Six Killings (liùshà), Five Ghosts (wǔguǐ), and Severed Fate (juémìng) (the Four Inauspicious) — from which it deduces the auspiciousness or inauspiciousness of the room layout.
